body:
Third of spec-1's six-personality creep roster. Skips the camp-escalation gate every other archetype needs -- marches toward the nearest node from spawn, still fights heroes in range along the way. Refactored is_swarmling (bool) into a proper archetype enum to make room, with a per-camp wave counter cycling spawns through all three types across successive waves. build.sh + test_arena.sh clean, 1188 PASS, no regressions. Commit fd21882.

⚓ ☃
title: Ravager: third camp-minion archetype, marches unconditionally (real immediate board pressure)
